title: Small CNFs for restricted DNF gates
statement: Let $n$ and $l$ be natural numbers, let $\mathrm{gates}_0,\dots,\mathrm{gates}_{s-1}$ be a family of DNF formulas in $n$ variables, and let $\rho$ be a restriction on the $n$ variables. Suppose that for every index $i$ the restricted function $x \mapsto (\mathrm{gates}_i)(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ has decision-tree depth at most $l$. Then for every index $i$ there is a CNF formula $\psi$ of width at most $l$ that computes this restricted function, that is, $\psi(x) = (\mathrm{gates}_i)(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ for every Boolean assignment $x$.
hypotheses_covered: n variables and width bound l
a family of DNF formulas indexed by i
each restricted gate has decision-tree depth ≤ l
replaced:
Given a family of $\mathrm{DNF}$ gates and a restriction $\rho$ under which every gate
satisfies $\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{gates}_i|_\rho)\le l$, every gate can be replaced by a
$\mathrm{CNF}$ of width at most $l$ computing $\mathrm{gates}_i|_\rho$ on all inputs.
